messages:
Samir (Sales): Great news — CedarPoint Retail's ISV app landed in the AppStore this morning. Listing live, trial enabled. :tada:
Jordan (Partnerships): Amazing! They signed a 2-yr dedicated + marketplace listing bundle, right?
Samir (Sales): Yep — 24-month commitment for Dedicated with a marketplace channel add-on. Legal signed off yesterday.
DeployBot: Marketplace listing published: https://marketplace.redwood.ai/apps/cedarpoint-retail (status: live)
Mel (Eng): Nice work. Quick heads-up: we routed initial traffic to rdx-dedicated-3 cluster. No errors in first 30m.
Tia (Ops): Confirmed. Autoscale policy applied (burst capacity ON). Watching logs for latency spikes.
Ava (CS): Onboarding kickoff scheduled for Wed 10am PT with CedarPoint success team.
Jordan (Partnerships): Can Marketing grab a quote + logo for the press tile? If legal approves, we'll do a short case study.
Samir (Sales): I'll ping the customer for a quick quote today. They loved the live demo of prefix caching and cost controls.
Mel (Eng): Performance note for docs: CedarPoint uses long-stream chat flows (avg seq 1.2k). We'll recommend KV cache TTL=12h.
Tia (Ops): FYI — billing integration with AppStore completed. Marketplace revenue share set per contract.
Ava (CS): Pls add CedarPoint to the pilot case studies doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/cs/case-studies
Jordan (Partnerships): Huge thanks team :rocket: — can we get a short blurb (1-2 sentences) in #announcements tomorrow?
Samir (Sales): Copy. I'll drop a blurb and link to the case study once marketing confirms assets.
Mel (Eng): If anyone sees error spikes, tag me @mel. I'm on standby for evening checks.
